Welcome to Mushroom Kingdom Adventures

Whether you are a heroic plumber or a helpful Toad, the Mushroom Kingdom provides endless adventures and exciting challenges in the 8-bit world. Grab a Super Mushroom and get ready for the specific challenges of stomping Goombas, dodging fireballs, and rescuing Princess Peach from Bowser's castle.

Get the Star Power!

Your ultimate defense against falling into lava, getting hit by spiked shells, or running out of time before reaching the flag pole.

  • Essential for throwing fireballs at Piranha Plants.
  • Great for smashing through brick blocks to find coins.

Secret Items

When exploring the levels, always remember to look for invisible blocks containing "1-Up Mushrooms" which give you an extra chance if your jump down a pipe mistakenly lands you in a bottomless pit.
